history_page.intro: districtry Iowa launched with the national tier: every county, both chambers of the Iowa Legislature, and Iowa's U.S. House delegation.

entries.title: Launched
entries.body: The national tier: county, U.S. House, Iowa Senate and Iowa House — four layers, statewide, each with a sourced boundary and (except county, identity-only by design) a weekly-refreshed officeholder roster. The flagship county-supervisor layer and the rest of the phase-1 roadmap follow in later PRs.
